Name: Scissor Phantasm
Information:
**Scissor Phantasm**

Some spirits are born from the unappeased souls of mortals, who collectively remain bound to a place or act that defined their life (or death). A Scissor Phantasm comes to be when the psychic energy of various souls who lost their lives to tragedy in the same place are twisted together, and become this terrible creature. Wielding a massive pair of blades in the shape of scissors, the Scissor Phantasm kills others to add their tragic souls to its own, in the same way a demon might. These spirits can come about as the result of a serial killer’s work. A Scissor Phantasm is often bound to the place where its component spirits died, and will sometimes refuse to permanently disperse unless their souls are laid to rest.

traits.name: Blurred
traits.description: The spirit’s form is uncertain, and difficult to properly see. Attacks against it have disadvantage. When it takes damage from an attack, the spirit loses this trait until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Ethereal Presence
traits.description: The spirit exists on the Material and Ethereal Planes simultaneously, and so can see and interact with anything on either. It can choose to move through whichever it wishes to when taking movement, allowing it to move through nonmagical materials on one side or the other, and it does not suffer a penalty to movement when moving through creatures.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The spirit’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spirit attacks twice with its Spectral Scissors, and twice with its Freezing Touch. It can cast a spell using Innate Spellcasting in place of its two Freezing Touch attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Scissors
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Freezing Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) cold damage. The spirit regains hit points equal to half the damage it deals with this attack, and the target’s maximum hit points are reduced by that amount until the next time they complete a Long Rest.

bonus_actions.name: Vanishing Act (Recharge 4-6)
bonus_actions.description: The spirit turns invisible. It remains invisible until the end of a turn in which it makes an attack or casts a spell.
